title: Dead Letter Queue Job Schema
description: Schema for jobs that have exceeded maximum retry attempts and moved to DLQ

job_id.description: Unique identifier for the failed job

workflow_name.description: Name of the n8n workflow that failed

failed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when job first failed

retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts made before moving to DLQ

error_message.description: Error message from the last failure

error_type.description: Type/category of error (e.g., ConnectionError, TimeoutError, ValidationError)

last_retry_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last retry attempt

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID for tracing across workflows
